query:
SELECT COUNT(*)
                FROM news
                WHERE (
                    ($1::bool AND published_at IS NOT NULL)
                    OR ($2::bool AND published_at IS NULL)
                )
                AND (
                    $3::TEXT IS NULL
                    OR title ILIKE '%' || $3 || '%'
                    OR content ILIKE '%' || $3 || '%'
                )
